title: International Day of Sign Languages
summary: The United Nations marks 23 September as the International Day of Sign Languages — the date the World Federation of the Deaf was founded in 1951. In 2026 the day also marks the WFD's 75th anniversary. A good night for documentaries, films and series that treat Deaf culture and sign languages as living languages, not as a plot device.
